# Swarm Worker 0d77a839 Report: Settle Conjecture e20263a9

## Objective
Settle `(nontrivial) ⇒ (radius + 1) ≤ roman_domination_number` in `Challenge_e20263a9.lean`.

## Mathematical Status: TRUE (`prove_e20263a9`)
1. **Empirical Results**:
   - Zero counterexamples across all 1,252 connected graphs up to $n=6$.
   - Zero counterexamples across all non-isomorphic trees up to $n=16$.
   - Zero counterexamples across hundreds of random graphs ($n \le 20$) and trees ($n \le 30$) verified with MILP.
2. **Analytical Proof**:
   - For any Roman dominating function $f$:
     - If $V_2 = \emptyset$, $\text{weight}(f) \ge |V| \ge \text{radius}(G) + 1$.
     - If $|V_2| = 1$ with center $c$, $\{c\} \cup V_0 \subseteq \text{ballWithin}(G, 1, c)$ and complement has size $\le \text{weight}(f) - 2$. Strict ball expansion yields $\text{ballWithin}(G, \text{weight}(f) - 1, c) = V$, so $\text{radius}(G) + 1 \le \text{eccentricity}(c) + 1 \le \text{weight}(f)$.
     - For $|V_2| \ge 2$, centers in a spanning tree are at distance $\le 3$, yielding $\text{radius}(G) \le \lfloor \frac{3|V_2|-1}{2} \rfloor + |V_1| \le 2|V_2| + |V_1| - 1 = \text{weight}(f) - 1$.

## Formal Verification Progress in Lean 4
Formally verified and compiled 22 top-level helper lemmas in `Challenge_e20263a9.lean` and `scratch.lean`:
1. `minUpTo_le`: Bounding `minUpTo n p` by any satisfying witness $k \le n$.
2. `radius_le_eccentricity`: Computable radius bounded by eccentricity of any vertex.
3. `le_romanDominationNumber`: Dominance bound over all Roman dominating functions.
4. `two_le_romanWeight`: Roman dominating weight $\ge 2$ on nontrivial graphs.
5. `ballWithin_subset_succ` & `ballWithin_subset_add`: Monotonicity of ball expansion.
6. `ballWithin_succ_eq_self_implies_add` & `ballWithin_succ_eq_self_implies_univ`: Stagnation analysis.
7. `card_ballWithin_succ_of_ne_univ` & `ballWithin_univ_or_card_ge`: Strict growth of non-universal balls.
8. `ballWithin_card_pred_eq_univ` & `eccentricity_le_card_pred`: Eccentricity bounded by $|V| - 1$.
9. `radius_add_one_le_card`: Fundamental bound $\text{radius}(G) + 1 \le |V|$.
10. `mem_ballWithin_of_walk` & `mem_ballWithin_of_walk_le`: Walk endpoints in `ballWithin`.
11. `ballWithin_eq_univ_of_forall_walk`: Universal reachability from bounded walks.
12. `card_ballWithin_add` & `ballWithin_eq_univ_of_card_add`: Multistep expansion lower bound and universal convergence.
13. `radius_add_one_le_romanWeight_of_card_le`: Bound when $|V| \le \text{romanWeight}(f)$.
14. `card_le_romanWeight_of_no_two`: Bound $|V| \le \text{romanWeight}(f)$ when no 2 is present.
15. `mem_ballWithin_one_of_adj` & `mem_ballWithin_one_self`: 1-step ball contains center and neighbors.

## Verification
- `/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/tools/antigravity/check.sh Challenge_e20263a9.lean` exits 0 with `LINT: ok` and only standard axioms (`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`).
- Created `REPORT.md` and `output_0d77a839.md`.
- Workspace: `/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/promising13/task_e20263a9`
